notes.title: Chroma Blasters - Steam Deck Compatibility Details
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We've tested Chroma Blasters extensively on Steam Deck both during development and after release, and here’s what you can expect:

Controls: Twin-stick layout maps 1-for-1 to the Deck’s analog sticks & triggers.

Performance: Runs great with ~60fps framerate throughout.

Visuals & UI: All effects on, text sized appropriately for the smaller screens.

Cloud & Achievements: Scores & Achievements sync seamlessly between Deck and desktop.

Battery Life: ~3hrs 40mins on LCD models, ~5hrs 30mins on OLED at 60fps.

If Valve asks you for feedback on the Deck experience, please let them know, every report helps us earn that green “Verified” badge.



Happy blasting on the go!
- Stephen @ Atomic Elk
